title: India WPI manufactured products, linked
description: Wholesale Price Index, manufactured products, monthly from April 2012: the 2011-12 base index divided by the Office of the Economic Adviser's published linking factor (1.44) to March 2023, the 2022-23 base index from April 2023; y/y calculated. Built by the AsiaDecoded/asia-vitals pipeline (in_ppi_oea, data/in/ppi/in_wpi_mfg_linked.csv).
schedule: Replaced after each monthly WPI release (14th) by a scheduled task that reads AsiaDecoded/asia-vitals.
